info.title: Axiom Lumen Public API
info.description: Persisted Stellar reconciliation snapshots. The production specification includes implemented routes only.

tags.name: Depth
tags.description: Classic SDEX cumulative order-book depth reconciliation

tags.name: Events
tags.description: Authorized live and replayed public snapshot notifications

get.summary: Get the latest finalized Public Network ledger snapshot

200.description: Current verified or degraded latest-ledger snapshot

400.description: Invalid request header or query parameter

503.description: Persisted metric state, read storage, or API access storage is unavailable

get.summary: Get the latest finalized Public Network supply snapshot

200.description: Current verified or degraded on-chain supply snapshot

400.description: Invalid asset, request header, or query parameter

404.description: No finalized snapshot exists for the asset

503.description: Persisted metric state, evidence freshness, read storage, or API access storage is unavailable

get.summary: Get the latest finalized Public Network SDEX depth snapshot

200.description: Current verified or degraded depth snapshot

400.description: Invalid pair, request header, or query parameter

404.description: No finalized snapshot exists for the pair

503.description: Persisted metric state, freshness, read storage, or API access storage is unavailable

get.summary: Get finalized Public Network trustline authorization-state counts

200.description: Current verified or degraded trustline-state snapshot

400.description: Invalid asset, request header, or query parameter

404.description: No finalized snapshot exists for the asset

503.description: Persisted metric state, freshness, read storage, or API access storage is unavailable

get.summary: Get reviewed public reserve disclosures for a verified anchor
get.description: Returns only publication-approved named-party flags and public corrections. An empty disclosures array does not reveal whether internal cases exist.

400.description: Invalid anchor, pagination, request header, or query parameter

404.description: No verified anchor exists for the identifier

503.description: The persisted public read model or API access storage is unavailable

get.description: Opens a server-sent event stream. Reconnect with the last received event ID to replay without silent gaps. Anchor reserve comparison snapshots are excluded because they require separate publication-state filtering.

200.description: SSE stream containing snapshot events, heartbeat comments, and terminal error events

400.description: Invalid request identifier, Last-Event-ID, or query parameter

409.description: The requested cursor cannot be resumed within the bounded replay window

503.description: Event storage, stream configuration, or API access verification is unavailable

AuthenticationError.description: API key is missing, malformed, expired, revoked, or inactive when authentication is required

AuthorizationError.description: The authenticated principal does not hold the scope required by this route, or the route is disabled for its plan

RateLimitError.description: The authenticated principal exhausted its sustained or burst quota for the current route window

Asset.name: asset
Asset.description: Canonical classic credit asset identifier CODE:ISSUER

Pair.name: pair
Pair.description: Canonical unordered pair as BASE~COUNTER; native sorts before credit assets

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the preceding anchor disclosure page

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Disclosure page size; defaults to 25 and cannot exceed 100

RequestId.name: X-Request-ID
RequestId.description: Optional caller correlation identifier; generated when absent

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Decimal ID of the last fully processed snapshot event; omitted connections begin live at the current tail

Vary.description: Cache representation varies by request identifier and API credential

RetryAfter.description: Seconds until a quota-limited request may be retried

XRateLimitLimit.description: Maximum requests in the current plan window

XRateLimitReset.description: UTC Unix timestamp when the fixed window resets
